overloadMerges.note: operator and text are both documented with the '←' arrow (values returned by the command), not '→'; auto-parse defaulted both to direction 'in'. Documents the QR Operators bit-flag constants for 'operator' as sentinelValues.

params.name: colNum
params.description: Column number of the cell whose data is retrieved

params.name: breakNum
params.description: List mode: subtotal/break row number, or -3 (qr grand total) for the grand total. Cross-table mode: row number of the cell.

params.name: operator
params.description: Sum of all operator constants present in the cell (0 if there is no operator)

sentinelValues.meaning: No operator present in the cell

params.name: text
params.description: Text present in the cell (returned only when the cell has no operator)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves the operator(s) and/or literal text configured for a given break/grand-total cell (list mode) or a given cell (cross-table mode).

jointConstraints.rule: operator and text are mutually exclusive: a given cell returns a result through exactly one of them (a non-zero operator, or non-empty text), never both.
